products.name: No.8 Bond Intense Moisture Mask
products.shortDescription: A concentrated, bond-building reparative mask formulated to add moisture, smoothness, and shine to damaged, chemically treated hair.
products.fullReview:
Olaplex No.8 Bond Intense Moisture Mask is positioned as a step up from the brand's original bond-maintenance line, built around the same patented bis-aminopropyl diglycol dimaleate technology found in Olaplex No.3, paired with a heavier moisture complex meant for hair that has been stressed by color services or heat styling.

The formula leans on ceramides, hyaluronic acid, squalane, and rose hip seed extract to target dehydration, alongside dimethicone and other conditioning agents that smooth the cuticle and add slip during detangling. Olaplex markets the mask around clinically and consumer-tested improvements in shine, moisture, smoothness, and body, though those figures come from the brand's own testing protocols rather than independent third-party comparison, so they should be read as brand-reported positioning rather than guaranteed personal results.

Because the mask is silicone-containing and fairly rich, it is designed to sit on top of hair rather than penetrate as deeply as a pure bond-rebuilding treatment, which makes it a good finishing or maintenance step for colored or lightened hair that already feels dry and brittle. It is vegan, cruelty-free, and formulated without sulfates, parabens, or phthalates, which keeps it compatible with most color-safe routines.

Readers should weigh the cost per ounce against the size of the bottle and consider whether they want a mask that can stand alone or one meant to complement other steps in Olaplex's bond-building system.
pros: Combines ceramides, hyaluronic acid, and squalane to target deep moisture loss in dry or color-treated strands
Uses Olaplex's patented bond-building ingredient alongside richer emollients for a dual repair-and-moisture approach
Vegan and cruelty-free formula free of sulfates, parabens, and phthalates
Concentrated texture is designed to absorb without weighing hair down
cons: Contains dimethicone and other silicones, which clean-beauty-focused shoppers may want to avoid
Brand-reported performance statistics come from in-house and sponsored testing rather than independent comparative studies
Smaller bottle size means the cost per use is higher than many drugstore or mass-market masks
products.bestFor: Color-treated or lightened hair that needs a rich, silicone-smoothed moisture boost, especially for those already using other steps in the Olaplex bond system.

products.name: Don't Despair, Repair! Deep Conditioning Mask
products.shortDescription: A rosehip and algae deep conditioning mask built to balance protein and moisture for dry, damaged, or chemically treated hair.
products.fullReview:
Briogeo's Don't Despair, Repair! Deep Conditioning Mask is explicitly positioned for people dealing with dry, damaged, chemically treated, or lifeless hair, which makes it a direct fit for anyone managing the dryness that often follows color services. The formula is built around rosehip oil and algae extract, supported by almond oil and biotin, with the brand framing the mix as a balance of protein and moisture rather than a straight protein treatment.

That protein-moisture balance matters for color-treated hair specifically, since over-reliance on protein-heavy masks can leave some hair types feeling stiff, while pure moisture masks alone may not address weakened bonds from bleach or repeated coloring. Briogeo positions the mask as part of its broader 6-free clean formulation standard, meaning it is made without sulfates, silicones, phthalates, parabens, DEA, and artificial dyes, which is a meaningful difference from heavier silicone-based masks for anyone trying to limit buildup on color-treated lengths.

The brand recommends using it as a weekly or biweekly treatment, left in for five to ten minutes, rather than a daily conditioner replacement, and it is sold across a wide range of sizes from a travel tube up to a jumbo 32-ounce tub, which gives shoppers room to trial it before committing to a larger size. The mask does include fragrance, so those with fragrance-sensitive scalps may want to patch test first.
pros: Explicitly formulated for dry, damaged, chemically treated, or lifeless hair, directly matching color-treated hair needs
Rosehip oil and algae extract target hydration and frizz without relying on silicones
Formulated under Briogeo's 6-free standard, free of sulfates, silicones, phthalates, parabens, DEA, and artificial dyes
Available in multiple sizes from a 2 oz travel tube to a 32 oz jumbo tub, making it easy to trial before buying a larger size
cons: Contains added fragrance (parfum), which may be a consideration for fragrance-sensitive or reactive scalps
Silicone-free formulas can feel less slip-heavy during detangling compared with silicone-based masks for some very coarse or curly textures
Best results depend on consistent weekly or biweekly use rather than occasional treatment
products.bestFor: Dry, color-treated, or chemically processed hair that needs a protein-and-moisture balance without added silicones or sulfates.

comparisons.title: Olaplex No.8 Bond Intense Moisture Mask vs. Briogeo Don't Despair, Repair! Deep Conditioning Mask
comparisons.subtitle: Two approaches to repairing dry, color-treated hair: silicone-smoothed bond technology versus a clean, protein-moisture balanced formula
comparisons.winnerReason: Briogeo's mask is explicitly formulated and marketed for dry, damaged, chemically-treated hair with a protein-moisture balance and a silicone-free, 6-free clean formulation, which maps more directly onto color-treated hair needs than Olaplex's heavier, silicone-containing moisture mask.
comparisons.verdict: Both masks can suit dry, color-treated hair, but they solve the problem differently. Olaplex No.8 leans on its patented bond-building ingredient plus a rich, silicone-smoothed moisture complex, making it a strong fit for those who already use other Olaplex bond-repair steps and want a heavier finishing treatment. Briogeo's Don't Despair, Repair! mask is built specifically around dry, damaged, and chemically-treated hair, balancing protein and moisture without sulfates, silicones, or parabens, and it comes in more size options for easier trial. Shoppers who want a clean-formula option sized for color-treated hair may prefer Briogeo, while those deep in the Olaplex system may prefer to stay with No.8 for consistency.
